# Prathamesh Belvalkar

> Solution Architect specializing in scalable backend systems and high-performance web apps with React, Node.js, NestJS, and Python. Explore portfolio and blog.

## About
Prathamesh Belvalkar is a Solution Architect and AI/Python developer focused on scalable backends, secure APIs, and high-performance web applications. Currently Assistant Solution Architect at Airrived AI, writing about architecture decisions, design reviews, ADRs, C4 diagrams, and AI backend data flows.

## Pages
- [Home](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/): Portfolio homepage with about, capabilities, experience, projects, and contact
- [Blog](https://prathameshbelvalkar.in/blog): Index of engineering and architecture articles
